words.enDefinition: A drawing showing the main process units and the material streams connecting them.

examples.en: The process flow diagram shows the two water streams joining before entering the next box.
examples.zh: 「工艺流程图」显示两股水流汇合后，再进入下一个方框。

examples.en: We marked the salt concentration beside each arrow in the classroom process flow diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂「工艺流程图」的每支箭头旁标注盐的浓度。

words.enDefinition: A high-level process drawing that represents major stages as blocks and their connections as arrows.

examples.en: The process block diagram groups the dessert preparation stages into three labelled boxes in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的「工艺方框图」用三个带标签的方框概括甜点制备阶段。

examples.en: We labelled the major stages on the process block diagram from left to right in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们从左到右标出「工艺方框图」的主要阶段。

collocations: simplify a process into a process block diagram

words.enDefinition: A piece of equipment or process stage regarded as one entity for analysis.

examples.en: The worksheet treats the mixing bowl as one process unit with clearly labelled material flows.
examples.zh: 练习将搅拌碗视为一个「工艺单元」，并清楚标出其物料流。

examples.en: We drew a separate balance around each process unit in the fictional food preparation line.
examples.zh: 我们对虚构食品制备流程中的各「工艺单元」分别列出衡算式。

words.enDefinition: Material represented as flowing between parts of a process or across its boundary.

examples.en: Each process stream is an arrow with a name in the simplified food mixing diagram.
examples.zh: 在简化的食品混合图中，每股「工艺物流」都用一支带名称的箭头表示。

examples.en: We added a mass fraction to the process stream that contains the sugar solution.
examples.zh: 我们在含糖溶液的这股「工艺物流」旁加上质量分数。

words.enDefinition: A table listing specified properties such as flow and composition for numbered process streams.

examples.en: The stream table lists water and dissolved sugar separately for each arrow in the example.
examples.zh: 示例的「物流数据表」为每支箭头分别列出水和溶解糖的数据。

examples.en: We used the stream table to locate the given composition before writing the balance equations.
examples.zh: 我们先用「物流数据表」查找已知组成，再写出衡算方程。

collocations: compare entries in a stream table

words.enDefinition: A name, number, or label linking a material stream on a drawing to its specifications.

examples.en: The stream identifier next to the upper arrow matches the first entry in the table.
examples.zh: 上方箭头旁的「物流标识」对应表中第一项。

examples.en: We checked the stream identifier before copying the given salt fraction into the equation.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「物流标识」，再把给定盐分数抄进方程。

words.enDefinition: A stream that supplies material to a process or one of its units.

examples.en: The feed stream brings the sugar solution into the first box shown on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 「进料物流」把糖溶液带入练习图上的第一个方框。

examples.en: We compared the feed stream with the finished mixture in the classroom material balance example.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂物料衡算示例中对比了「进料物流」与最终混合物。

words.enDefinition: A process stream carrying the intended output from a process or unit.

examples.en: The product stream carries the blended juice out of the final box on the drawing.
examples.zh: 「产品物流」把混合果汁从图上最后一个方框带出。

examples.en: We wrote the sugar fraction for the product stream after balancing sugar and water.
examples.zh: 我们对糖和水列出衡算后，写下「产品物流」的糖质量分数。

words.enDefinition: A stream of material crossing a chosen boundary into a system or unit.

examples.en: The inlet stream crosses the dashed boundary where the top arrow points into the box.
examples.zh: 上方箭头指入方框处，「入口物流」穿过虚线边界。

examples.en: We counted each inlet stream before writing the water balance for the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先数清各股「入口物流」，再为课堂示意图列写水的衡算。

words.enDefinition: A stream of material crossing a chosen boundary out of a system or unit.

examples.en: The outlet stream leaves through the right side of the system boundary in the drawing.
examples.zh: 图中的「出口物流」从系统边界右侧流出。

examples.en: We marked the outlet stream separately from the arrow that loops within the same boundary.
examples.zh: 我们将「出口物流」和在同一边界内折返的箭头分开标记。

words.enDefinition: Material supplied from outside a system before it is combined with any material returned internally.

examples.en: Fresh feed enters the fictional juice process through the upper arrow in the block diagram.
examples.zh: 在工艺方框图中，「新鲜进料」沿上方箭头进入虚构的果汁流程。

examples.en: We kept fresh feed separate from the returned stream when labelling the process boundary.
examples.zh: 标注工艺边界时，我们将「新鲜进料」和返回物流分别列出。

words.enDefinition: A process stream directed back to an earlier stage of the same system.

examples.en: The recycle stream bends back toward the first box in the classroom water loop diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂水循环图中，「回流物流」折回第一个方框。

examples.en: We did not count the recycle stream as an external input to the whole process.
examples.zh: 对整个工艺衡算时，我们只把「回流物流」当作内部流动。

words.enDefinition: The connected path carrying material downstream and then back to an earlier process point.

examples.en: The recycle loop is entirely inside the broad boundary drawn around our classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型外围画的大边界完全包住「回流回路」。

examples.en: We traced the recycle loop through the boxes before identifying the flows that leave the system.
examples.zh: 我们先沿各方框追踪「回流回路」，再找出离开系统的各股物流。

words.enDefinition: A stream that deliberately removes some material from a recycle loop.

examples.en: The purge stream leaves the model water loop as a labelled arrow on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习纸上，带标签的箭头表示离开模型水循环的「排放支流」。

examples.en: We included the purge stream when counting exits from the boundary around the entire diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在统计整个示意图边界上的出口时，计入了「排放支流」。

collocations: purge stream from a recycle loop

words.enDefinition: A location in a process diagram where two or more streams join into a single stream.

examples.en: The mixing point joins the plain water stream and the sugar solution in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，清水流和糖溶液在「汇合点」汇合。

examples.en: We assigned one label to the stream leaving the mixing point in our classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 我们给课堂图中离开「汇合点」的物流加了一个标签。

words.enDefinition: A location where one stream divides into two or more outlet streams.

examples.en: The split point is shown as a junction with one incoming arrow and two outgoing arrows.
examples.zh: 「分流点」画成一个有一支入箭头和两支出箭头的交点。

examples.en: We compared the material entering and leaving the split point in the water diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在水流程图上比较了进出「分流点」的物料。

words.enDefinition: The portion of an incoming stream's flow directed into a specified outlet of a splitter.

examples.en: The split fraction identifies which share of the entering water follows the lower arrow in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「分流分数」表明流入水量中沿下方箭头分走的份额。

examples.en: We checked that the worksheet's two outlet values for split fraction add up to one.
examples.zh: 我们核对练习纸上两个出口的「分流分数」之和等于一。

words.enDefinition: A ratio expressing recycle flow relative to a stated reference flow, commonly fresh feed.

examples.en: The recycle ratio compares the returning water with the fresh feed in this worksheet convention.
examples.zh: 按练习纸的定义，「回流比」将回流的水与新鲜进料作比较。

examples.en: We read the denominator beside the recycle ratio because the example specifies its own reference stream.
examples.zh: 由于示例自行指定了参考物流，我们查看「回流比」旁标出的分母。

collocations: recycle ratio on a mass basis

words.enDefinition: A process in which the components do not undergo chemical reactions within the chosen boundary.

examples.en: The nonreactive process in the exercise simply combines water with a prepared sugar solution.
examples.zh: 练习的「非反应过程」只是把水与配制好的糖溶液混合。

examples.en: We tracked the same components at every boundary in the nonreactive process shown on paper.
examples.zh: 我们追踪了纸面「非反应过程」各处边界的同一组组分。

words.enDefinition: A process that handles a finite amount of material as one discrete run.

examples.en: The batch process in the classroom chart follows one bowl of mixture from start to finish.
examples.zh: 课堂图中的「间歇过程」跟踪一碗混合物从开始到结束。

examples.en: We compared the initial and final material amounts for the illustrated batch process on paper.
examples.zh: 我们在纸上比较图示「间歇过程」的初始与最终物料量。

collocations: material balance for a batch process

words.enDefinition: A process in which material enters and leaves on an ongoing basis during operation.

examples.en: The continuous process diagram shows prepared juice coming in while blended juice leaves another side.
examples.zh: 「连续过程」图显示配好的果汁一边流入，混合果汁一边从另一侧流出。

examples.en: We distinguished the continuous process from repeated batches when reading the two fictional diagrams.
examples.zh: 阅读两张虚构的工艺图时，我们区分了「连续过程」与反复批量操作。

words.enDefinition: A process handling a discrete batch while at least one material crosses its boundary during the run.

examples.en: The semibatch process example adds a water stream while the mixture stays in the vessel.
examples.zh: 「半间歇过程」示例中，混合物留在容器里，同时有一股水流加入。

examples.en: We identified the arrow that enters during the run in the semibatch process diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在「半间歇过程」图上找出了运行期间进入的箭头。

collocations: material balance for a semibatch process

words.zhGloss: 质量到物质的量的换算
words.enDefinition: Expressing a mass as an amount of substance by dividing by the relevant molar mass.
acceptedZhAnswers: 质量到物质的量的换算

examples.en: The mass-to-mole conversion changes the units used for the same quantity of sugar in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「质量到物质的量的换算」改变了表达同一份糖所用的计量单位。

examples.en: We applied mass-to-mole conversion before comparing water and dissolved sugar in the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先做「质量到物质的量的换算」，再比较课堂练习中的水和溶解糖。

words.enDefinition: A calculation basis expressing amounts or fractions in terms of mass.

examples.en: The mass basis keeps every ingredient amount in grams for the worksheet's simple mixing example.
examples.zh: 按「质量基准」，练习的简单混合示例将各食材用量统一用克表示。

examples.en: We compared the sugar fractions on a mass basis before reading the corresponding mole fractions.
examples.zh: 我们先按「质量基准」比较糖的分数，再读取相应的摩尔分数。

words.enDefinition: A calculation basis expressing amounts or fractions in moles.

examples.en: The mole basis reports the amounts of water and dissolved sugar in moles in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习按「摩尔基准」，用摩尔表示水和溶解糖的量。

examples.en: We converted the stated masses to a mole basis before comparing the two component fractions.
examples.zh: 我们先把给定质量换算到「摩尔基准」，再比较两个组分的分数。

words.enDefinition: The mass of a component divided by the total mass of the mixture.

examples.en: We found the mass fraction of sugar by dividing the sugar mass by the total mass.
examples.zh: 我们用糖的质量除以总质量，求得糖的「质量分数」。

examples.en: The mass fraction stays the same when the entire classroom mixture is scaled by one factor.
examples.zh: 整个课堂混合物按同一倍数缩放时，「质量分数」保持不变。

words.enDefinition: The number of moles of one component divided by the total number of moles in the mixture.

examples.en: The mole fraction uses amount in moles for both the component and the complete mixture.
examples.zh: 「摩尔分数」的分子和分母分别用组分与整个混合物的摩尔数。

examples.en: We checked that the mole fraction of each component contributes to a total of one.
examples.zh: 我们核对各组分的「摩尔分数」之和是否为一。

words.enDefinition: A component's mass fraction expressed as a percentage.

examples.en: The mass percent of sugar is printed beside the ingredient label in our fictional exercise.
examples.zh: 虚构练习中的食材标签旁印着糖的「质量百分数」。

examples.en: We converted the given mass fraction into mass percent before filling in the worksheet table.
examples.zh: 我们将给定的质量分数换算成「质量百分数」，再填入练习表格。

words.enDefinition: A component's mole fraction expressed as a percentage.

examples.en: The mole percent in the table comes from the mole fraction of the same component.
examples.zh: 表中的「摩尔百分数」由同一组分的摩尔分数得出。

examples.en: We converted mole percent to a fraction before writing the component amount in the balance.
examples.zh: 我们将「摩尔百分数」换算为分数，再在衡算中写出组分量。

words.enDefinition: A way to express a component fraction using the total mass including moisture as the denominator.

examples.en: The wet basis uses the full mass of the sample, including water, in the denominator.
examples.zh: 「湿基」采用包含水分的样品总质量作为分母。

examples.en: We read the moisture result on a wet basis before comparing it with another label.
examples.zh: 我们先按「湿基」读取含水量，再将结果与另一个标签比较。

collocations: moisture content on a wet basis

words.enDefinition: A way to express a component amount relative to the mass of material excluding moisture.

examples.en: The dry basis expresses moisture relative to the sample's dry solids in our classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例按「干基」表示含水量，即用样品干固形物的质量作基准。

examples.en: We converted the illustrated moisture figure to a dry basis using the stated solids mass.
examples.zh: 我们利用给出的固形物质量，将图示含水量换算到「干基」。

collocations: moisture content on a dry basis

words.enDefinition: The mass of the nonwater portion of a material in the stated analysis.

examples.en: The dry solids mass remains unchanged when the worksheet adds plain water to the fictional mixture.
examples.zh: 向虚构混合物加入清水时，练习中的「干固形物质量」保持不变。

examples.en: We subtracted the water mass to determine the dry solids mass in the sample balance.
examples.zh: 我们减去水的质量，以求出样例衡算中的「干固形物质量」。

collocations: dry solids mass of a sample

words.enDefinition: The requirement that comparable terms in an equation have compatible physical dimensions.

examples.en: Dimensional consistency requires both sides of the worksheet equation to represent amounts of the same kind.
examples.zh: 「量纲一致性」要求练习方程两侧代表同类物理量。

examples.en: We checked dimensional consistency before adding quantities copied from different columns of the stream table.
examples.zh: 我们先核查「量纲一致性」，再把物流数据表不同列中抄出的量相加。

words.enDefinition: The removal of matching units from a numerator and denominator when manipulating a calculation.

examples.en: The unit cancellation leaves grams after multiplying the mass by a suitable conversion factor in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，质量乘适当的换算因子后，经「单位约消」留下克。

examples.en: We wrote every unit to make the unit cancellation visible on the calculation sheet.
examples.zh: 我们写出各个单位，使计算纸上的「单位约消」一目了然。

words.enDefinition: The stated reference quantity used to express how much of a component is present.

examples.en: The concentration basis is stated as mass per volume in the classroom table of sugar solutions.
examples.zh: 课堂糖溶液表里，「浓度基准」注明为质量除以体积。

examples.en: We checked the concentration basis before comparing two labels printed on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「浓度基准」，再比较练习纸上印出的两个标签。

words.enDefinition: An accounting equation relating material inflow and outflow, accumulation, and any internal generation or consumption of the specified material.

examples.en: The material balance accounts for each water stream crossing the boundary on the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 「物料衡算」计入课堂练习纸上穿过边界的每股水流。

examples.en: We wrote the material balance before substituting the amounts listed beside the arrows in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先写出「物料衡算」，再代入各箭头旁列出的物料量。

words.enDefinition: A material balance for the total mass of all components combined.

examples.en: The total mass balance uses the mass of the whole solution at both crossing points.
examples.zh: 「总质量衡算」在两个穿越边界处都用整个溶液的质量。

examples.en: We applied a total mass balance before working out the separate sugar and water quantities.
examples.zh: 我们先应用「总质量衡算」，再分别求糖和水的量。

words.enDefinition: A material balance tracking one specified component through a system.

examples.en: The component balance follows only the dissolved sugar in the diagram on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习图中的「组分衡算」只追踪溶解的糖。

examples.en: We wrote a component balance for water before comparing it with the total mass balance.
examples.zh: 我们先为水列写「组分衡算」，再将其与总质量衡算作比较。

words.enDefinition: A balance drawn around an entire process, counting only transfers across its external boundary.

examples.en: The overall process balance omits the recycle stream because the arrow stays inside the boundary.
examples.zh: 「全流程衡算」省略回流物流，因为它的箭头留在边界内部。

examples.en: We used an overall process balance before looking separately at two sections of the food diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先做「全流程衡算」，再分别看食品流程图中的两个部分。

collocations: overall process balance across a boundary

words.enDefinition: A material balance for a system with no time change in the relevant stored amounts.

examples.en: The steady-state material balance sets the accumulation term to zero for the classroom tank model.
examples.zh: 课堂容器模型做「稳态物料衡算」时，将积累项设为零。

examples.en: We solved the steady-state material balance using the constant flows stated in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用练习给出的恒定流量求解「稳态物料衡算」。

words.enDefinition: A material balance that includes the change of stored amounts with time.

examples.en: The transient material balance tracks the rising water inventory in the container shown on paper.
examples.zh: 「瞬态物料衡算」追踪纸面容器里随时间增加的储水量。

examples.en: We sketched the inventory predicted by the transient material balance for the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们画出课堂示例中「瞬态物料衡算」给出的存量曲线。

collocations: transient material balance for a vessel

words.enDefinition: A balance written in quantities per unit time, including the rate of accumulation if relevant.

examples.en: The rate balance uses mass per minute for every term in the worksheet model.
examples.zh: 练习模型的「速率衡算」让各项都用每分钟的质量表示。

examples.en: We integrated the rate balance to compare the amounts at two times in the example.
examples.zh: 我们对「速率衡算」积分，比较示例中两个时刻的物料量。

words.enDefinition: A material balance that compares transfers and changes in stored amounts over a finite time interval.

examples.en: The integral material balance compares the total water entering during the interval with the inventory increase.
examples.zh: 「积分式物料衡算」将时段内流入的总水量与存量增加量比较。

examples.en: We wrote an integral material balance using the start and end amounts on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们根据练习给出的起始量与结束量，写出「积分式物料衡算」。

collocations: integral material balance over an interval

words.enDefinition: A balance term representing material entering through the boundary during the specified period or per unit time.

examples.en: The inflow term is the sum of the two incoming water streams in the classroom equation.
examples.zh: 课堂方程的「流入项」是两股流入水流的总和。

examples.en: We wrote the inflow term before accounting for the water leaving from the right side.
examples.zh: 在计入从右侧流出的水之前，我们先写出「流入项」。

words.enDefinition: A balance term representing material leaving through the chosen system boundary.

examples.en: The outflow term accounts for the arrow carrying the blended mixture out of the diagram.
examples.zh: 「流出项」计入图中把混合物带出的那支箭头。

examples.en: We checked which arrow belongs in the outflow term on the classroom water diagram.
examples.zh: 我们核对课堂水流程图中哪支箭头应计入「流出项」。

words.enDefinition: A balance term giving the change or rate of change of a quantity stored within the system.

examples.en: The accumulation term is positive when the amount of water inside the container is increasing.
examples.zh: 容器内水量增加时，「积累项」为正。

examples.en: We retained the accumulation term because the amount in the classroom model changes with time.
examples.zh: 由于课堂模型中的物料量随时间变动，我们保留了「积累项」。

words.enDefinition: The amount of material present within a process unit or selected region at a given time.

examples.en: The material holdup equals the amount of liquid currently inside the drawn bowl in class.
examples.zh: 课堂中，「物料持有量」等于图示容器当前所装的液体量。

examples.en: We read the material holdup from the state shown halfway through the simulated mixing exercise.
examples.zh: 我们从模拟混合练习进行一半时的状态读取「物料持有量」。

words.enDefinition: The quantity of material inside the chosen boundary at the beginning of a balance interval.

examples.en: The initial inventory identifies how much sugar solution is already inside the vessel in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「初始存量」表示容器内开始时已有多少糖溶液。

examples.en: We copied the initial inventory from the first column before calculating the net accumulated amount.
examples.zh: 我们从第一列抄下「初始存量」，再计算净积累量。

words.enDefinition: The quantity of material inside the chosen boundary at the end of a balance interval.

examples.en: The final inventory includes the water already present and the additional water retained in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习里的「期末存量」包含先前已有的水和随后留在容器里的水。

examples.en: We compared final inventory with the result predicted by our material balance in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「期末存量」与物料衡算预测值进行比较。

words.enDefinition: A condition in which the total stored amount stays unchanged even if material enters and leaves.

examples.en: Constant holdup results in the model when the total incoming and outgoing mass rates match.
examples.zh: 模型里，总流入和总流出质量速率相同时，实现「恒定持有量」。

examples.en: We showed that constant holdup can coexist with a changing salt fraction in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们说明练习中「恒定持有量」可与变化的盐质量分数并存。

collocations: maintain constant holdup in a model

words.enDefinition: The time span over which the material entering, leaving, and accumulating in a system is compared.

examples.en: The balance interval starts with the first reading and ends with the last reading in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的「衡算时段」从第一次读数开始，到最后一次读数结束。

examples.en: We used the same balance interval for every stream amount in the classroom table.
examples.zh: 课堂表中各股物流的物料量统一采用同一个「衡算时段」。

collocations: total flow over a balance interval

words.enDefinition: A stated value or relation describing a stream's flow, composition, or another property in a problem.

examples.en: The stream specification gives the sugar mass fraction of the solution entering the model vessel.
examples.zh: 「物流给定条件」给出了进入模型容器的溶液中糖的质量分数。

examples.en: We underlined each stream specification before counting the quantities still unknown on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先给各项「物流给定条件」画下划线，再统计图中未知量。

words.enDefinition: Counting unknowns and independent equations to determine whether a process balance has enough information.

examples.en: Degree-of-freedom analysis reveals that the two unknown flows require independent equations in the example.
examples.zh: 「自由度分析」表明，示例中的两个未知流量需要独立方程才能确定。

examples.en: We performed degree-of-freedom analysis before attempting to solve the classroom mixing problem on paper.
examples.zh: 我们先做「自由度分析」，再尝试在纸上求解课堂混合问题。

words.enDefinition: A balance equation that adds a constraint beyond the other equations already listed.

examples.en: The independent balance equation adds information about the sugar amount in the classroom mixture.
examples.zh: 这条「独立衡算方程」增加了课堂混合物中糖含量的信息。

examples.en: We checked whether the total mass equation was an independent balance equation after writing both components.
examples.zh: 写完两个组分的方程后，我们核查总质量方程是否为「独立衡算方程」。

words.enDefinition: A balance equation that follows from others and adds no new constraint to the system.

examples.en: The redundant balance equation follows by adding the two component equations on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习纸上的「冗余衡算方程」可以由两个组分方程相加得到。

examples.en: We kept the redundant balance equation as a check on copying the values correctly.
examples.zh: 我们保留「冗余衡算方程」，用来核查抄入的数值。

words.enDefinition: The difference left after evaluating the two sides of a balance equation with given data.

examples.en: The balance residual is small after the class substitutes the rounded flow values into the equation.
examples.zh: 全班把取整后的流量值代入方程后，「衡算残差」很小。

examples.en: We examined the balance residual before deciding whether the worksheet values were consistent.
examples.zh: 我们先查看「衡算残差」，再判断练习纸上的数值是否一致。

words.enDefinition: Agreement among the terms of a balance to within a stated tolerance.

examples.en: The balance closure improves after using unrounded masses from the table in the synthetic example.
examples.zh: 合成示例改用表中未经取整的质量后，「衡算闭合」情况改善。

examples.en: We checked balance closure by comparing the calculated total with the reported outlet amount.
examples.zh: 我们将计算总量与报告的出口量比较，以核查「衡算闭合」。

words.enDefinition: A balance residual expressed relative to a stated reference amount, often as a percentage.

examples.en: The relative closure error uses the total incoming water as its reference in this exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「相对闭合误差」采用总流入水量作基准。

examples.en: We reported the denominator used for the relative closure error in the classroom balance table.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂衡算表里注明「相对闭合误差」所用的分母。

words.enDefinition: A modelling assumption that composition is uniform throughout a selected volume at each instant.

examples.en: The well-mixed assumption gives the vessel contents one sugar fraction at each simulated time.
examples.zh: 「充分混合假设」使模拟中容器内物料在每个时刻都用一个糖质量分数表示。

examples.en: We used the well-mixed assumption to relate the outlet composition to the contents in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们利用「充分混合假设」把出口物流组成与容器内物料组成对应起来。

words.enDefinition: A balance relating the amounts and compositions entering a mixing point to those of the combined stream.

examples.en: The mixing balance combines the water and sugar contributions from both arrows on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 「混合衡算」将练习图中两支箭头上水和糖的贡献相加。

examples.en: We solved the mixing balance to find the composition labelled beside the outgoing arrow.
examples.zh: 我们求解「混合衡算」，找出出箭头旁所标的组成。

words.enDefinition: A balance for dividing one stream into multiple exits, with equal compositions for an ideal simple splitter.

examples.en: The splitter balance gives the same salt fraction for both outgoing streams in the ideal drawing.
examples.zh: 对于图中的理想分流，「分流衡算」给出两股出口物流相同的盐分数。

examples.en: We checked the splitter balance using the total water shown at each branch on paper.
examples.zh: 我们用纸面上各支路标出的总水量核查「分流衡算」。

words.enDefinition: A material balance that tracks a solute and solvent when extra solvent changes their ratio.

examples.en: The dilution balance keeps the sugar amount unchanged when the example adds only plain water.
examples.zh: 示例中只加入清水时，「稀释衡算」使糖的量保持不变。

examples.en: We used a dilution balance to explain the smaller sugar fraction shown in the second drawing.
examples.zh: 我们用「稀释衡算」解释第二张图所示糖质量分数较低的原因。

words.enDefinition: The mass of one component carried by a stream per unit time.

examples.en: The component mass flow rate for sugar is part of the stream's total mass flow rate.
examples.zh: 糖的「组分质量流率」是该股物流总质量流率的一部分。

examples.en: We used the component mass flow rate when writing the sugar balance for the outlet.
examples.zh: 我们列写出口物流的糖衡算时，用到了「组分质量流率」。

collocations: calculate a component mass flow rate
component mass flow rate of water
component mass flow rate in a stream

words.enDefinition: The amount of substance carried by a stream per unit time, expressed in moles per time.

examples.en: The molar flow rate is shown below the stream arrow in the example table of units.
examples.zh: 示例单位表把「摩尔流率」列在物流箭头下方。

examples.en: We converted a given mass flow into a molar flow rate for the water stream.
examples.zh: 我们把给定质量流率换算为这股水流的「摩尔流率」。

collocations: molar flow rate of a component

words.enDefinition: The mass of a component divided by the volume of the mixture.

examples.en: The mass concentration gives sugar mass per unit of solution volume in our classroom table.
examples.zh: 课堂表里的「质量浓度」表示每单位溶液体积所含的糖质量。

examples.en: We checked the units of mass concentration before using the number in the water balance.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「质量浓度」的单位，再把该数值用于水溶液衡算。

words.enDefinition: The amount in moles of a component divided by the volume of the mixture.

examples.en: The molar concentration reports the amount of dissolved sugar per unit volume in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「摩尔浓度」表示每单位体积所含溶解糖的摩尔数。

examples.en: We converted sugar mass to moles before calculating molar concentration from the given solution volume.
examples.zh: 我们先把糖的质量换算为摩尔数，再根据给定溶液体积求「摩尔浓度」。

words.enDefinition: An identifiable substance assumed not to react, form, or disappear within the modelled system.

examples.en: The fictional dye serves as a conservative tracer in the water diagram on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 虚构染料在练习水流程图里用作「守恒示踪物」。

examples.en: We tracked the conservative tracer entering and leaving the water region in the simplified classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 在简化的课堂练习中，我们追踪了进出水域的「守恒示踪物」。

words.enDefinition: The amount of a particular component present within the system boundary at a specified time.

examples.en: The component inventory shows how much salt is inside the model vessel at the recorded instant.
examples.zh: 「组分存量」表示在记录时刻模型容器里的盐量。

examples.en: We compared the component inventory at two times before calculating the change in stored salt.
examples.zh: 我们先比较两个时刻的「组分存量」，再算容器中存盐量的变化。

words.enDefinition: An accounting equation for energy crossing a chosen outer boundary and changing inside it.

examples.en: The overall energy balance includes the heat added to the water in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 「整体能量衡算」包括课堂图中加入水里的热量。

examples.en: We wrote one overall energy balance around both containers shown in the fictional food example.
examples.zh: 我们对虚构食品示例中的两个容器合在一起列出一条「整体能量衡算」。

words.enDefinition: An energy balance whose terms are all expressed as energy per unit time.

examples.en: The energy balance in rate form uses watts for each energy transfer on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习在「速率形式的能量衡算」中用瓦特表示各项能量传递速率。

examples.en: We compared the energy balance in rate form with one written over a finite interval.
examples.zh: 我们将「速率形式的能量衡算」与针对有限时段列写的衡算作了比较。

collocations: write an energy balance in rate form
apply an energy balance in rate form
solve an energy balance in rate form

words.enDefinition: An energy balance for a steady flow through a control volume with no net energy accumulation.

examples.en: The steady-flow energy balance accounts for energy entering and leaving with the water streams on paper.
examples.zh: 纸面上的「稳流能量衡算」计入随各股水流进出的能量。

examples.en: We used the steady-flow energy balance after confirming that the model temperatures stay fixed with time.
examples.zh: 确认模型温度不随时间改变后，我们应用了「稳流能量衡算」。

collocations: steady-flow energy balance for a mixer

words.enDefinition: An energy balance that includes the change of stored energy as time passes.

examples.en: The transient energy balance predicts the temperature of water that starts at room temperature in the simulation.
examples.zh: 模拟中，「瞬态能量衡算」预测初始温度为室温的水在随后各时刻的温度。

examples.en: We included the warming of the contents in the transient energy balance for the class model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型的「瞬态能量衡算」中计入容器内物料的升温。

collocations: transient energy balance for a vessel

words.enDefinition: The change or rate of change of energy stored within the chosen boundary.

examples.en: Energy accumulation is positive while the water's stored energy increases in our classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型中，水所储存的能量增多时，「能量积累」为正。

examples.en: We identified the energy accumulation term before comparing the two heat transfer arrows in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先找出「能量积累」项，再比较两支表示传热的箭头。

words.enDefinition: The rate of heat input or removal required by a specified process task.

examples.en: The heat duty in the example refers to warming the illustrated stream of water.
examples.zh: 示例中的「热负荷」指加热图示水流所需的热功率。

examples.en: We read the sign of the heat duty before deciding whether the model adds heat.
examples.zh: 我们读取「热负荷」的正负号，再判断模型是加热还是移出热量。

words.enDefinition: The amount of thermal energy transferred as heat per unit time.

examples.en: The heat transfer rate is reported in watts in the worksheet's comparison of two containers.
examples.zh: 比较两个容器的练习用瓦特报告「传热速率」。

examples.en: We compared heat transfer rate with the total transferred energy shown over the whole interval.
examples.zh: 我们把「传热速率」与整个时段的传热总量作了比较。

collocations: heat transfer rate through a wall

words.enDefinition: The rate of heat transfer per unit area, with direction when treated as a vector.

examples.en: The heat flux points through the wall from the warm side toward the cooler side.
examples.zh: 「热流密度」穿过壁面，指向由较暖一侧到较冷一侧。

examples.en: We multiplied the uniform heat flux by surface area to find the total transfer rate.
examples.zh: 我们用均匀的「热流密度」乘以表面积，求总传热速率。

words.enDefinition: The heat added to a system minus the heat leaving it over the same interval.

examples.en: Net heat input is positive when more heat enters than leaves the modelled container.
examples.zh: 进入模型容器的热量大于离开的热量时，「净输入热量」为正。

examples.en: We calculated net heat input by comparing the two heat arrows in the classroom balance.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂衡算图中的两支热量箭头，计算「净输入热量」。

collocations: net heat input over an interval

words.enDefinition: Transfer of heat from a system across its boundary to its environment.

examples.en: The heat loss to the surroundings is shown by an outward arrow on the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 课堂草图用向外箭头表示「向环境散热」。

examples.en: We included heat loss to the surroundings when comparing the two illustrated cooling curves in class.
examples.zh: 课堂比较两条图示冷却曲线时，我们计入「向环境散热」。

collocations: account for heat loss to the surroundings
estimate heat loss to the surroundings
model heat loss to the surroundings

words.enDefinition: The rate of enthalpy carried by a stream, obtained from its mass flow rate and specific enthalpy.

examples.en: The enthalpy flow rate uses the given specific enthalpy for the incoming water in the example.
examples.zh: 示例的「焓流率」计算使用进水给定的比焓。

examples.en: We added the enthalpy flow rate of each entering stream in the worksheet energy balance.
examples.zh: 我们在练习的能量衡算中把各股流入物流的「焓流率」相加。

words.enDefinition: The state at which a reference enthalpy is assigned for a consistent set of calculations.

examples.en: The worksheet uses the same enthalpy reference state for every water stream in the balance.
examples.zh: 练习纸在衡算中对所有水流都使用同一个「焓基准状态」。

examples.en: We identified the enthalpy reference state before comparing entries from the two classroom tables.
examples.zh: 我们先确认「焓基准状态」，再比较两张课堂表中的数据。

words.enDefinition: The difference in a stream's specific enthalpy between two specified states, on the stated basis.

examples.en: The stream enthalpy change is positive because the outlet water is warmer in the simple model.
examples.zh: 简单模型中，出口水更暖，所以「物流焓变」为正。

examples.en: We calculated the stream enthalpy change using two readings from the same water property table.
examples.zh: 我们用同一张水物性表的两项数据计算「物流焓变」。

words.enDefinition: Heating that raises temperature without a phase change.

examples.en: The sensible heating example follows water that stays liquid throughout the illustrated temperature change.
examples.zh: 「显热加热」示例中的水在整个图示温度变化期间都保持液态。

examples.en: We identified the sensible heating portion of the temperature plot before interpreting the energy balance.
examples.zh: 我们先找出温度图中对应「显热加热」的一段，再解读能量衡算。

words.enDefinition: Cooling that lowers temperature without a phase change.

examples.en: The sensible cooling example shows liquid water losing heat while remaining in the same phase.
examples.zh: 「显热冷却」示例显示液态水放热，同时保持相态不变。

examples.en: We calculated the heat removed during sensible cooling using the classroom property table for water.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂水物性表，计算「显热冷却」期间移出的热量。

words.enDefinition: Heat transfer through a material or across contact due to microscopic interactions driven by a temperature difference.

examples.en: Thermal conduction carries energy through the solid divider in the diagram of two water containers.
examples.zh: 在两个水容器的示意图中，能量通过固体隔板进行「热传导」。

examples.en: We used thermal conduction to explain how energy crosses the wall without the wall moving.
examples.zh: 我们用「热传导」解释固体壁面不移动时，能量如何穿过它。

words.enDefinition: Heat transfer involving the motion of a fluid, commonly between a fluid and a surface.

examples.en: Thermal convection transfers heat between the moving air and the wall of the example container.
examples.zh: 「对流换热」使流动空气与示例容器壁之间发生热量传递。

examples.en: We compared thermal convection with conduction through the solid wall in the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 我们比较了课堂草图中的「对流换热」与固体壁内的热传导。

words.enDefinition: Energy emitted as electromagnetic radiation because of a body's temperature.

examples.en: Thermal radiation transfers energy between the two drawn surfaces even across the empty intervening space.
examples.zh: 隔着中间的空隙，图中的两个表面仍可通过「热辐射」传递能量。

examples.en: We discussed thermal radiation as a separate heat transfer mechanism in the example diagram.
examples.zh: 我们将「热辐射」作为示例图中的一种传热机制加以讨论。

words.enDefinition: The relation in which conductive heat flux is proportional to the negative temperature gradient.

examples.en: Fourier's law of conduction connects the temperature gradient to the heat flux in the solid.
examples.zh: 「傅里叶导热定律」将固体中的温度梯度与热流密度联系起来。

examples.en: We used Fourier's law of conduction to explain the sign of flux on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用「傅里叶导热定律」解释练习中热流密度的符号。

collocations: derive a result from Fourier's law of conduction

words.enDefinition: A material property relating conductive heat flux to a given temperature gradient.

examples.en: The larger thermal conductivity gives a larger heat flux at the same temperature gradient here.
examples.zh: 在这里，温度梯度相同时，较大的「热导率」对应较大的热流密度。

examples.en: We compared thermal conductivity values for two sample materials listed in the classroom handout.
examples.zh: 我们比较了课堂讲义所列两种样品材料的「热导率」。

words.enDefinition: The spatial rate and direction of temperature increase, expressed as a vector.

examples.en: The temperature gradient points toward increasing temperature through the layer in the example diagram.
examples.zh: 示例图里，「温度梯度」沿该层中温度升高的方向。

examples.en: We used the slope of the temperature curve to read the one-dimensional temperature gradient.
examples.zh: 我们根据温度曲线的斜率，读出一维「温度梯度」。

words.enDefinition: The ratio of a temperature difference to the resulting heat transfer rate for the specified path.

examples.en: The thermal resistance is larger for the thicker layer of the same material in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，同种材料的层越厚，「热阻」越大。

examples.en: We represented each heat transfer step by its thermal resistance in the simplified wall model.
examples.zh: 在简化壁面模型中，我们用对应的「热阻」表示各段传热过程。

words.enDefinition: The sum of thermal resistances for successive steps carrying the same steady heat transfer rate.

examples.en: The series thermal resistance adds the resistances of both wall layers in the worksheet model.
examples.zh: 练习模型中，两层壁面的热阻相加得到「串联总热阻」。

examples.en: We checked the constant transfer rate through the layers before finding the series thermal resistance.
examples.zh: 我们确认各段传热速率相同后，求出「串联总热阻」。

words.enDefinition: A wall model consisting of layers of different materials through which heat can be conducted.

examples.en: The composite wall has two different material layers between the warm and cool sides in class.
examples.zh: 课堂里的「多层复合壁」在暖侧和冷侧之间含两层不同材料。

examples.en: We marked each material boundary in the composite wall before drawing its temperature profile.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「多层复合壁」各材料间的边界，再画温度分布。

collocations: heat conduction through a composite wall

words.enDefinition: A conduction model in which temperature varies along only one spatial coordinate.

examples.en: The one-dimensional conduction model assumes that temperature varies only across the thickness of the wall.
examples.zh: 「一维导热」模型假定温度只沿壁厚方向变化。

examples.en: We used one-dimensional conduction to simplify the flat layer drawn on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用「一维导热」简化练习图中的平板层。

words.enDefinition: Heat conduction with a temperature field that does not change with time.

examples.en: The steady conduction example has fixed temperatures on both outside faces of the classroom slab.
examples.zh: 「稳态导热」示例中，课堂平板两个外表面的温度固定。

examples.en: We compared the constant heat flux in steady conduction with the changing flux shown earlier.
examples.zh: 我们比较「稳态导热」中的恒定热流密度与之前画出的变动热流密度。

words.enDefinition: Heat conduction in which the temperature field changes with time.

examples.en: The transient conduction example shows the slab warming gradually after one outside face becomes warmer.
examples.zh: 「瞬态导热」示例显示一个外表面变暖后，平板逐渐升温。

examples.en: We compared temperature profiles at two times during transient conduction in the classroom simulation.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂模拟中「瞬态导热」在两个时刻的温度分布。

words.enDefinition: The ratio of thermal conductivity to volumetric heat capacity, measuring how quickly temperature changes spread through a material.

examples.en: Thermal diffusivity helps explain why the two simulated slabs approach uniform temperature at different rates.
examples.zh: 「热扩散率」有助于解释两块模拟平板为何以不同速率趋于温度均匀。

examples.en: We read the thermal diffusivity in the supplied material table before comparing the temperature traces.
examples.zh: 比较温度曲线前，我们先读取给定材料表中的「热扩散率」。

words.enDefinition: A body's capacity to store energy per unit rise in temperature in a lumped thermal model.

examples.en: The thermal capacitance is larger for the larger amount of water in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 课堂模型中，水量较多的一组具有较大的「热容」。

examples.en: We used thermal capacitance to explain why one model body warms more slowly than the other.
examples.zh: 我们用「热容」解释一个模型物体为什么升温比另一个慢。

collocations: thermal capacitance in a lumped model

words.enDefinition: A heat transfer model that treats a body as having one uniform, time-varying temperature.

examples.en: The lumped-capacitance model assigns one temperature to the entire piece at each time in the example.
examples.zh: 示例的「集总热容模型」在每一时刻用同一个温度描述整个物体。

examples.en: We discussed whether the lumped-capacitance model was appropriate for the illustrated temperature profiles in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们讨论「集总热容模型」是否适用于图示的温度分布。

words.enDefinition: A dimensionless ratio comparing internal conduction resistance with surface convection resistance for a body.

examples.en: The Biot number compares internal opposition to heat flow with the surface resistance in the model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，「毕奥数」比较内部导热热阻和表面热阻。

examples.en: We used the Biot number to discuss whether internal temperature gradients matter in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们利用「毕奥数」讨论课堂模型中内部温度梯度是否重要。

words.enDefinition: Resistance to heat transfer across the interface where two materials touch.

examples.en: The thermal contact resistance produces a temperature jump at the interface in our simplified drawing.
examples.zh: 简化图中，「接触热阻」使界面处出现温度突变。

examples.en: We included thermal contact resistance between the two solid layers in the classroom thermal network.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂热阻网络中计入两个固体层之间的「接触热阻」。

collocations: thermal contact resistance at an interface

words.enDefinition: A representation of how temperature varies with position at a specified time or steady condition.

examples.en: The temperature profile shows how the temperature changes with depth through the two classroom layers.
examples.zh: 「温度分布曲线」显示温度在课堂示例的两个层中如何随深度变化。

examples.en: We sketched the temperature profile using the labelled temperatures at the left and right faces.
examples.zh: 我们根据左右两侧标出的温度，画出「温度分布曲线」。

words.enDefinition: A coefficient relating convective heat flux to a temperature difference between a surface and the bulk fluid.

examples.en: The convective heat transfer coefficient appears beside the air side of the wall in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图把「对流换热系数」标在壁面的空气侧。

examples.en: We compared the given convective heat transfer coefficient for two idealized cases in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习里两个理想化情形各自给出的「对流换热系数」。

collocations: convective heat transfer coefficient at a surface
estimate a convective heat transfer coefficient

words.enDefinition: The model stating that convective heat transfer rate per area equals a heat transfer coefficient times the temperature difference between a surface and the surrounding fluid.

examples.en: Newton's law of cooling relates the modelled heat loss to the temperature difference in the drawing.
examples.zh: 「牛顿冷却定律」把图中模拟的热量损失与温差联系起来。

examples.en: We applied Newton's law of cooling after assuming a constant heat transfer coefficient in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先假定换热系数恒定，再应用「牛顿冷却定律」。

collocations: cooling curve from Newton's law of cooling
model with Newton's law of cooling

words.enDefinition: Fluid motion produced by buoyancy from density differences, contributing to transfer of heat or mass.

examples.en: Natural convection appears in the diagram as gently rising air next to the warm container.
examples.zh: 图里暖容器旁缓慢上升的空气表示「自然对流」。

examples.en: We explained natural convection by comparing the densities of cooler and warmer fluid in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上比较较冷与较暖流体的密度，解释「自然对流」。

words.enDefinition: Fluid motion imposed by an external device or pressure source, contributing to heat or mass transfer.

examples.en: Forced convection is shown by the directed water flow beside the surface in the sketch.
examples.zh: 草图在表面旁画出有方向的水流，表示「强制对流」。

examples.en: We compared forced convection and buoyancy-driven flow in the two idealized classroom diagrams.
examples.zh: 我们比较两张理想化课堂图中的「强制对流」与浮力驱动流动。

words.enDefinition: A reference temperature representing the main fluid away from a surface or averaged over the flowing stream.

examples.en: The bulk fluid temperature represents the main water stream outside the thin near-wall region.
examples.zh: 「流体主体温度」表示近壁薄层之外主体水流的温度。

examples.en: We compared bulk fluid temperature with the temperature of the surface in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂示例中的「流体主体温度」与表面温度。

collocations: bulk fluid temperature at a location

words.enDefinition: The resistance relating a surface-to-fluid temperature difference to the rate of convective heat transfer.

examples.en: The convective thermal resistance links the wall surface and water in the classroom thermal network.
examples.zh: 课堂热阻网络里，「对流热阻」把壁面与水连接起来。

examples.en: We used convective thermal resistance as one term in the simplified comparison of two cases.
examples.zh: 在简化对比两个情形时，我们将「对流热阻」作为其中一项。

collocations: convective thermal resistance at a wall

words.enDefinition: A region near a surface in which the fluid temperature changes from the surface value toward the bulk value.

examples.en: The thermal boundary layer appears near the wall where water temperature changes across a short distance.
examples.zh: 「热边界层」出现在壁面附近，水温在很短的距离内发生变化。

examples.en: We located the thermal boundary layer by comparing the local and bulk temperatures on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 通过比较练习上的局部温度与主体温度，我们定位了「热边界层」。

collocations: temperature in the thermal boundary layer
thermal boundary layer next to a wall

words.enDefinition: The difference between a surface temperature and a representative bulk fluid temperature for convection.

examples.en: The surface-to-fluid temperature difference is positive when the model wall is warmer than the passing water.
examples.zh: 模型壁面比流过的水更暖时，「表面与流体的温差」为正。

examples.en: We read the surface-to-fluid temperature difference before discussing the direction of heat transfer on paper.
examples.zh: 我们先读出「表面与流体的温差」，再在纸面上讨论传热方向。

collocations: sign of the surface-to-fluid temperature difference

words.enDefinition: The ratio of radiation emitted by a surface to that of a blackbody at the same temperature under corresponding conditions.

examples.en: The surface with higher emissivity emits more radiation at the same temperature in the textbook model.
examples.zh: 教材模型里，温度相同时，「发射率」较高的表面发出更多辐射。

examples.en: We compared emissivity values for the two marked surfaces using the provided classroom material table.
examples.zh: 我们用给定的课堂材料表比较两个标记表面的「发射率」。

words.enDefinition: An ideal body that absorbs all incident radiation and emits the maximum thermal radiation for its temperature.

examples.en: The blackbody serves as the reference emitter in the classroom comparison of two warm surfaces.
examples.zh: 在课堂比较两个温暖表面时，「黑体」作为参考辐射体。

examples.en: We used a blackbody to define the reference emission at each illustrated temperature on paper.
examples.zh: 我们用「黑体」定义纸面上各图示温度的参考发射量。

words.enDefinition: The law stating that the total emitted thermal power per unit area of a blackbody scales with absolute temperature to the fourth power.

examples.en: The Stefan-Boltzmann law uses absolute temperature in the classroom calculation of emitted power per area.
examples.zh: 课堂计算单位面积发射功率时，「斯特藩—玻尔兹曼定律」采用绝对温度。

examples.en: We used the Stefan-Boltzmann law to compare the emission from the same ideal surface at two temperatures.
examples.zh: 我们用「斯特藩—玻尔兹曼定律」比较同一个理想表面在两种温度下的发射量。

words.enDefinition: The rate of thermal radiation transfer per unit area, stated as emitted, received, or net.

examples.en: The radiative heat flux in this exercise is marked per unit area of the model surface.
examples.zh: 练习中的「辐射热流密度」按模型表面的单位面积列出。

examples.en: We compared radiative heat flux with the other mechanisms shown beside the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们比较「辐射热流密度」与课堂示意图旁所示的其他传热方式。

words.enDefinition: The difference between radiation energy transfers in opposite directions for the specified system or surfaces.

examples.en: The net radiative exchange is zero in the ideal two-surface enclosure when both temperatures are equal.
examples.zh: 在仅有两个表面的理想封闭空间内，两表面同温时，「净辐射换热」为零。

examples.en: We considered both emission and absorption when interpreting the net radiative exchange on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 解读练习中的「净辐射换热」时，我们同时考虑发射和吸收。

words.enDefinition: The geometric fraction of radiation leaving a surface diffusely that directly reaches a specified surface.

examples.en: The radiation view factor depends on how the two surfaces face one another in the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 课堂草图中，「辐射角系数」取决于两个表面彼此朝向的方式。

examples.en: We compared the radiation view factor for two different arrangements drawn on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习纸所画两种布置各自的「辐射角系数」。

words.enDefinition: The movement of a component between regions or phases by diffusion, fluid motion, or both.

examples.en: Mass transfer moves dissolved sugar between neighbouring regions of water in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 在课堂示意图中，溶解糖借「传质」在相邻水区间移动。

examples.en: We discussed mass transfer separately from the simultaneous movement of thermal energy in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们把「传质」与同时发生的热量传递分别讨论。

words.enDefinition: Transport arising from random molecular motion, producing net movement when concentration is nonuniform.

examples.en: Molecular diffusion gradually evens out the sugar concentration in the still water model shown in class.
examples.zh: 课堂静水模型里，「分子扩散」使糖浓度逐渐变得均匀。

examples.en: We drew the changing concentration profile to illustrate molecular diffusion in the fictional water layer.
examples.zh: 我们绘出变化的浓度分布，用于说明虚构水层中的「分子扩散」。

words.enDefinition: Transfer of a component involving fluid motion, often modelled between a surface and the bulk fluid.

examples.en: Convective mass transfer relates the moving water and the dissolved sugar near a model surface.
examples.zh: 「对流传质」联系流动的水和模型表面附近的溶解糖。

examples.en: We contrasted convective mass transfer with diffusion alone in the two simplified diagrams on paper.
examples.zh: 我们对照纸上两张简化图，比较「对流传质」与单独扩散。

collocations: convective mass transfer at a surface

words.enDefinition: The spatial rate and direction of concentration increase, represented as a vector.

examples.en: The concentration gradient points toward the higher sugar concentration in the example's one-dimensional drawing.
examples.zh: 在示例的一维图中，「浓度梯度」指向糖浓度较高的方向。

examples.en: We compared the concentration gradient at two marked locations on the classroom solution profile.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂溶液分布图中两个标记位置的「浓度梯度」。

words.enDefinition: A property relating diffusive flux to a concentration gradient for a specified component and medium.

examples.en: The diffusion coefficient differs for the two dissolved substances listed in the classroom data table.
examples.zh: 课堂数据表中，两种溶解物质的「扩散系数」不同。

examples.en: We used the stated diffusion coefficient to interpret the two synthetic concentration profiles.
examples.zh: 我们用给定的「扩散系数」解读两条合成浓度分布曲线。

words.enDefinition: The rate of transfer of a component by diffusion per unit area relative to a specified reference velocity.

examples.en: The diffusive flux points toward lower concentration in the simple classroom model of sugar in water.
examples.zh: 在糖溶于水的简单课堂模型中，「扩散通量」指向浓度较低处。

examples.en: We compared diffusive flux at two locations with different gradients on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习中梯度不同的两个位置的「扩散通量」。

words.enDefinition: The amount in moles of a specified substance crossing unit area per unit time.

examples.en: The molar flux reports the dissolved sugar crossing the marked area per unit time in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，「摩尔通量」用摩尔数表示溶解糖每单位时间通过单位面积的量。

examples.en: We checked the molar flux units before comparing quantities across the two classroom columns.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「摩尔通量」的单位，再比较课堂表两列的量。

words.enDefinition: The mass crossing unit area per unit time, for a specified component or the entire mixture.

examples.en: The mass flux gives the water amount crossing the marked surface per unit area and time.
examples.zh: 「质量通量」表示单位时间内穿过标记表面单位面积的水的质量。

examples.en: We distinguished mass flux from the total mass flow rate across the whole area in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们区分了「质量通量」与穿过整个面积的总质量流率。

words.enDefinition: The relation in which diffusive flux is proportional to the negative concentration gradient under the model assumptions.

examples.en: Fick's first law gives a flux opposite to the direction of increasing concentration in this example.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，「菲克第一定律」给出的通量方向与浓度升高方向相反。

examples.en: We used Fick's first law to interpret the sign of dissolved salt flux on paper.
examples.zh: 我们用「菲克第一定律」解读纸面上溶解盐通量的正负号。

collocations: flux predicted by Fick's first law

words.enDefinition: The diffusion equation stating that the time derivative of concentration equals the negative divergence of diffusive flux in the absence of sources.

examples.en: Fick's second law describes how the shape of the sugar concentration profile changes in the simulation.
examples.zh: 「菲克第二定律」描述了模拟中糖浓度分布的形状随时间怎样变化。

examples.en: We discussed Fick's second law when reading the different snapshots of the closed water layer.
examples.zh: 阅读封闭水层在不同时刻的图时，我们讨论了「菲克第二定律」。

collocations: concentration profile from Fick's second law

words.enDefinition: A diffusion model in which concentration varies along only one spatial coordinate.

examples.en: The model assumes one-dimensional diffusion because the displayed concentration changes only across the water layer.
examples.zh: 图示浓度只沿水层厚度方向变化，所以模型假定为「一维扩散」。

examples.en: We represented one-dimensional diffusion on paper with a single distance axis and a concentration curve.
examples.zh: 我们在纸面上用单条距离轴和一条浓度曲线表示「一维扩散」。

words.enDefinition: Diffusion with a concentration field that does not change with time.

examples.en: The steady diffusion example retains the same concentration profile at each recorded moment in class.
examples.zh: 课堂「稳态扩散」示例在每个记录时刻都保持同样的浓度分布。

examples.en: We compared the flux in steady diffusion with the earlier model whose concentration changes over time.
examples.zh: 我们比较「稳态扩散」的通量与之前浓度随时间变化的模型。

words.enDefinition: Diffusion in which the concentration field changes with time.

examples.en: The transient diffusion example shows the initial sugar concentration profile becoming flatter as time passes.
examples.zh: 「瞬态扩散」示例显示，随时间过去，初始糖浓度分布逐渐变平。

examples.en: We compared two simulated snapshots during transient diffusion in the classroom water example.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂水相示例的「瞬态扩散」在两个时刻的模拟图。

words.enDefinition: A region near an interface where concentration changes from an interfacial value toward a bulk value.

examples.en: The concentration boundary layer marks where the dissolved sugar level changes close to the model surface.
examples.zh: 「浓度边界层」标出靠近模型表面且溶解糖浓度发生变化的区域。

examples.en: We drew the concentration boundary layer separately from the thermal layer in the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂草图上把「浓度边界层」与热边界层分开绘制。

collocations: concentration boundary layer near a surface
profile in a concentration boundary layer

words.enDefinition: A coefficient relating mass transfer flux to a stated concentration difference under the chosen model.

examples.en: The mass transfer coefficient links the modelled sugar flux to the concentration difference in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习里的「传质系数」把模拟的糖通量与浓度差联系起来。

examples.en: We read the given mass transfer coefficient before identifying its driving force in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先读出给定「传质系数」，再指出课堂示意图中的相应推动力。

collocations: units of a mass transfer coefficient

words.enDefinition: The concentration used to represent the main body of a fluid away from a specified interface.

examples.en: The bulk concentration is read in the main body of the liquid in the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中从液体主体部分读出「主体浓度」。

examples.en: We compared bulk concentration with the value at the wall in the classroom solution model.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂溶液模型中的「主体浓度」与壁面处的浓度。

words.enDefinition: The concentration of a component on a specified side of the boundary between phases or materials.

examples.en: The interfacial concentration is labelled on the liquid side of the line in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习把「界面浓度」标在分界线的液体侧。

examples.en: We compared interfacial concentration with the value in the main liquid on the class sketch.
examples.zh: 我们比较课堂草图中的「界面浓度」与液体主体内的浓度。

words.enDefinition: The difference that drives mass transfer in a model, often expressed through a concentration difference.

examples.en: The mass transfer driving force is represented by the difference between two marked sugar concentrations.
examples.zh: 这里用两个标记的糖浓度之差来表示「传质推动力」。

examples.en: We checked the sign of the mass transfer driving force on the classroom water diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂水相示意图上核对「传质推动力」的正负号。

collocations: identify a mass transfer driving force
sign of the mass transfer driving force

words.enDefinition: A characteristic time for diffusion over a specified distance, scaling with distance squared divided by diffusivity.

examples.en: The diffusion time scale is longer for the wider water layer in our simplified comparison.
examples.zh: 在简化比较中，较宽的水层具有较长的「扩散时间尺度」。

examples.en: We compared two diffusion time scale estimates using the given layer widths in the classroom worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂练习给出的层宽，比较两个「扩散时间尺度」估计值。
